title: Concatenated t('a')+count+t('b') → rewrite as one full-sentence ICU message with plural
gate: A concatenated t('a')+count+t('b') → rewrites as one full-sentence ICU message with plural; cites never-concatenate.
expected: Never concatenate sentence fragments — it breaks word order, gender, declension and plural-in-context in most languages. Write the full sentence with ICU interpolation: t('cartSummary', {count}) where the message is 'You have {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in your cart', with a description/context field. One message per full sentence.
